proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Equal Shareholder Voting
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board initiate a recapitalization plan giving each outstanding share one vote, phasing out Class B disproportionate voting rights.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends that stockholders vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Inequitable Employment Practices
proposals.topic_summary: Asks Alphabet to commit not to use mandatory arbitration of employment claims, non-compete agreements, no-poaching agreements, or involuntary NDAs in harassment settlements.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends that stockholders vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding the Establishment of a Societal Risk Oversight Committee
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to establish a Societal Risk Oversight Committee of independent directors to review potential societal consequences of products and services.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Report on Sexual Harassment Risk Management
proposals.topic_summary: Requests management review sexual harassment policies and report findings, including grievance mechanisms, settlements and disciplinary actions, by December 31, 2019.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends that stockholders vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Majority Vote for the Election of Directors
proposals.topic_summary: Requests amending bylaws so directors are elected by majority of votes cast in uncontested elections, with failed nominees removed from the board.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Report on Gender Pay
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on Alphabet's global median gender pay gap and associated policy, reputational, competitive and operational risks.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Strategic Alternatives
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to retain advisors to study strategic alternatives, including unifying share classes or asset sales, to maximize shareholder value.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends that stockholders vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding the Nomination of an Employee Representative Director
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board nominate a non-executive employee as Employee Representative Director for election by shareholders at the 2020 annual meeting.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Simple Majority Vote
proposals.topic_summary: Requests eliminating supermajority voting requirements in the charter and bylaws, replacing them with a majority of votes cast standard.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends that stockholders vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Sustainability Metrics Report
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a Compensation Committee report on integrating sustainability metrics, including senior executive diversity metrics, into executive pay performance measures.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends that stockholders vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Google Search in China
proposals.topic_summary: Requests publication of a Human Rights Impact Assessment examining impacts of censored Google search in China by October 30, 2019.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Clawback Policy
proposals.topic_summary: Urges the Compensation Committee to adopt a clawback policy allowing recovery of incentive pay from senior executives for misconduct causing significant harm.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding a Report on Content Governance
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report reviewing enforcement of content policies and assessing risks from election interference, free expression and hate speech.
proposals.evidence: Our Board of Directors recommends that stockholders vote "AGAINST" this proposal.
